anda: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend (noun) [契交]
keġeldügsen: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü-, participle -gsen, 'that have said to one another, mutually declared' (verb, reciprocal participle) [相說的]
ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]
josun: josun — custom, reason, the right way (noun) [理]
waṅ-qān: Waṅ-Qān — Wang Qan, ruler of the Kereid (personal name; Chinese wang 'prince' + qan) [人名]
ečige-jüġen: ečige — father; reflexive-possessive -jüġen, 'one's own father' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [父親 自的行]
qān-u: qān — ruler, sovereign, khan (title, the short form beside qaγan); genitive -u, 'of the Qan' (title + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝的]
deġü-neri: deġü — younger brother; plural -ner, accusative (i), 'younger brothers (object)', before the reflexive -jen that follows as the token jen (noun + plural + case; the (i) is Shiratori's) [弟 每自的行]
tula: tula — because of, on account of (postposition; the Ming 上頭 'on top of', hence 'for that reason') [上頭]
qān: qān — ruler, sovereign, khan (title, the short form beside qaγan; here after a name) [皇帝]
bolulčažu: bolulča- — to agree, come to terms (stem inferred; Ming 相從); converb -žu, 'agreeing' (verb, converb) [相從着] · also 'doing together' (Ming 共做着), as in anda bolulčažu, 'making sworn brotherhood together'; the same stem bolulča-, but the Ming here is 共做 'do together', not 相從 'follow'
qabčal: qabčal — narrow place, defile (noun; Ming 窄狹處) [窄狹處]
γarču: γar- — to go out; converb -ču, 'going out' (verb, converb) [出着] · also γar- 'to go up, come up' (Ming 上着) [上着]
qān-dur: qān — ruler, khan (the short form beside qaγan); dative-locative -dur, 'to the qan' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
ima-ji: ima — him, her (pronoun; the stem is uncertain); accusative -ji, 'him (object)' (pronoun + case) [將他] · also the Ming 敎他 'cause him' (so perhaps 'make him …'; the stem ima is unclear)
öġesün: öġesün — oneself, himself, emphatic (pronoun; Ming 自己) [自己]
morilažu: morin — horse; verb-forming -la-, converb -žu, 'mounting' (noun-derived verb, converb) [上馬着]
žüg: žüg — direction, side, place; after a name, 'toward' (noun used as a postposition) [處] · also žüg, 'each' (repeated: 'each each') (Ming 各 'each'), in the entrusting of the posts
hüldežü: hülde- — to chase, overtake (stem inferred from the Ming 趕); converb -žü, 'chasing' (verb, converb) [趕了]
irge: irge — wether, castrated ram (noun; Ming 羯羊) [羯羊] · also 'people' (Ming 百姓), a form of irgen, as in tede irge ičuγaγad 'those people, having turned back'
